{% app_script "landing-runtime-tabs" %} (function(){ var root =
document.querySelector('[data-runtime-tabs]'); if(!root) return; var tabs =
root.querySelectorAll('[data-runtime-tab]'); var panels =
root.querySelectorAll('[data-runtime-panel]'); tabs.forEach(function(tab){
tab.addEventListener('click', function(){ tabs.forEach(function(t){
t.removeAttribute('aria-current'); t.classList.remove('bg-stone-50',
'dark:bg-stone-950'); t.classList.add('bg-white', 'dark:bg-stone-900'); });
tab.setAttribute('aria-current', 'true'); tab.classList.remove('bg-white',
'dark:bg-stone-900'); tab.classList.add('bg-stone-50', 'dark:bg-stone-950'); var
key = tab.getAttribute('data-runtime-tab'); panels.forEach(function(panel){ var
active = panel.getAttribute('data-runtime-panel') === key;
panel.classList.toggle('opacity-100', active);
panel.classList.toggle('translate-y-0', active);
panel.classList.toggle('pointer-events-auto', active);
panel.classList.toggle('opacity-0', !active);
panel.classList.toggle('translate-y-2', !active);
panel.classList.toggle('pointer-events-none', !active); }); }); }); })(); {%
end_app_script %} {% app_script "landing-platform-animation" %} (function(){
function sleep(ms) { return new Promise(function(resolve){ setTimeout(resolve,
ms); }); } function setState(island, stateName) {
island.querySelectorAll(".landing-island-state").forEach(function(state){
state.classList.toggle("is-visible", state.classList.contains("landing-island-"
+ stateName)); }); } function setupDeviceCard(card) { if
(card.dataset.platformDeviceReady === "true") return;
card.dataset.platformDeviceReady = "true"; var island =
card.querySelector(".landing-dynamic-island"); if (!island) return; var
idleWidth = Number(island.dataset.idleWidth || 28); var loadingWidth =
Number(island.dataset.loadingWidth || 16); var doneWidth =
Number(island.dataset.doneWidth || 40); var sequence = 0; var touchTimer = null;
function reset() { sequence += 1; island.style.width = idleWidth + "px";
setState(island, "idle"); card.classList.remove("is-active"); } function start()
{ var current = ++sequence; card.classList.add("is-active"); setState(island,
"none"); sleep(100).then(function(){ if (current !== sequence) return;
island.style.width = loadingWidth + "px"; setState(island, "loading"); return
sleep(1000); }).then(function(){ if (current !== sequence) return;
setState(island, "none"); island.style.width = doneWidth + "px"; return
sleep(100); }).then(function(){ if (current !== sequence) return;
setState(island, "done"); }); } setState(island, "idle");
card.addEventListener("pointerenter", function(event){ if (event.pointerType !==
"touch") start(); }); card.addEventListener("pointerleave", function(event){ if
(event.pointerType !== "touch") reset(); }); card.addEventListener("focusin",
start); card.addEventListener("focusout", reset); card.addEventListener("click",
function(){ if (!window.matchMedia("(pointer: coarse)").matches) return;
clearTimeout(touchTimer); start(); touchTimer = setTimeout(reset, 2500); }); }
function animateConnectorBeams(root) { if (root.dataset.platformBeamReady ===
"true") return; root.dataset.platformBeamReady = "true"; var reduce =
window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches; var beams =
Array.prototype.slice.call(root.querySelectorAll(".landing-connector-beam")).map(function(svg){
return { delay: Number(svg.dataset.delay || 0), stops:
Array.prototype.slice.call(svg.querySelectorAll(".landing-beam-stop")), }; });
if (!beams.length || reduce) return; var starts = [-25, -20, -10, -5]; var ends
= [100, 105, 115, 120]; function frame(time) { if
(!document.documentElement.contains(root)) return; var seconds = time / 1000;
beams.forEach(function(beam){ var local = (seconds - beam.delay) % 3; if (local
< 0) local += 3; var progress = local < 2 ? local / 2 : 1;
beam.stops.forEach(function(stop, index){ var offset = starts[index] +
(ends[index] - starts[index]) * progress; stop.setAttribute("offset", offset +
"%"); }); }); requestAnimationFrame(frame); } requestAnimationFrame(frame); }
function initLandingPlatformAnimation() {
document.querySelectorAll("[data-platform-animation]").forEach(function(root){
root.querySelectorAll(".landing-device-card").forEach(setupDeviceCard);
animateConnectorBeams(root); }); } initLandingPlatformAnimation();
window.addEventListener("app-router:patch", initLandingPlatformAnimation); })();
{% end_app_script %}
{% app_script "landing-api-card" %}
(function(){
    var hoverable = window.matchMedia("(hover:hover) and (pointer:fine)").matches;
    var pathsApi = [
        ["M161 27.2506L43.1043 27.2506L31.6449 27.2506L0 27.2506", 200, 2000, true],
        ["M289 23.5L349.401 23.5C352.085 23.5 354.59 22.1543 356.071 19.9166L366.555 4.08336C368.037 1.84567 370.542 0.499992 373.225 0.499992L394.599 0.49999", 750, 2000, false],
        ["M289 27.5L334.757 27.5C337.408 27.5 339.887 28.8132 341.376 31.0065L352.23 46.9935C353.719 49.1868 356.198 50.5 358.848 50.5L393.599 50.5", 800, 2000, false],
        ["M289 31.5L321.643 31.5C324.278 31.5 326.745 32.798 328.237 34.9703L363.999 87.0297C365.491 89.202 367.957 90.5 370.593 90.5L375 90.5", 850, 2000, false]
    ];
    var state = new WeakMap();

    function classHas(el, value) {
        return ((el && el.getAttribute && el.getAttribute("class")) || "").split(/\s+/).indexOf(value) !== -1;
    }

    function findByStyle(root, value) {
        var needle = value.replace(/\s+/g, "");
        return Array.prototype.slice.call(root.querySelectorAll("[style]")).find(function(el) {
            return (el.getAttribute("style") || "").replace(/\s+/g, "").indexOf(needle) !== -1;
        });
    }

    function svgFor(path, delay, repeat, reverse, viewBox) {
        var id = "landingApiGradient" + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2);
        return '';
    }

    function setupApi(card) {
        var stage = card.querySelector(".absolute.top-0.left-1\\/2.h-\\[140px\\]") ||
            Array.prototype.slice.call(card.querySelectorAll("div")).find(function(el) {
                return classHas(el, "absolute") && classHas(el, "top-0") && classHas(el, "left-1/2") && classHas(el, "h-[140px]");
            });
        if (stage) {
            Array.prototype.slice.call(stage.children).filter(function(el) {
                return el.tagName === "DIV" && classHas(el, "pointer-events-none") && classHas(el, "absolute") && classHas(el, "z-2");
            }).forEach(function(el, index) {
                if (pathsApi[index]) {
                    el.innerHTML = svgFor(pathsApi[index][0], pathsApi[index][1], pathsApi[index][2], pathsApi[index][3], "0 0 410 91");
                }
            });
        }

        var screen = findByStyle(card, "rotateX(-75deg)");
        if (screen) {
            screen.dataset.apiScreen = "";
            if (screen.firstElementChild) {
                screen.firstElementChild.dataset.apiScreenLight = "";
            }
            var user = findByStyle(screen, "opacity:0");
            if (user) {
                user.dataset.apiUser = "";
                var progress = user.querySelector(".will-change-\\[width\\]");
                if (progress) {
                    progress.dataset.apiProgress = "";
                }
            }
        }

        var laptopAnchor = card.querySelector(".absolute.bottom-0.z-100") ||
            Array.prototype.slice.call(card.querySelectorAll("div")).find(function(el) {
                return classHas(el, "absolute") && classHas(el, "bottom-0") && classHas(el, "z-100");
            });
        if (laptopAnchor && laptopAnchor.firstElementChild) {
            laptopAnchor.firstElementChild.dataset.apiLaptopY = "";
        }

        var auth = card.querySelector(".absolute.top-1\\/2.left-1\\/2.z-10") ||
            Array.prototype.slice.call(card.querySelectorAll("div")).find(function(el) {
                return classHas(el, "absolute") && classHas(el, "top-1/2") && classHas(el, "left-1/2") && classHas(el, "z-10") && el.textContent.indexOf("Authenticating") !== -1;
            });
        var spinner = auth && auth.querySelector(".shrink-0");
        if (spinner) {
            spinner.dataset.apiSpinner = "";
        }

        card._rackGroups = [
            { rects: Array.prototype.slice.call(card.querySelectorAll("#rectangleContainer rect")), dots: Array.prototype.slice.call(card.querySelectorAll("#circleContainer circle")) },
            { rects: Array.prototype.slice.call(card.querySelectorAll("#rectangleContainer_3 rect")), dots: Array.prototype.slice.call(card.querySelectorAll("#circleContainer_3 circle")) },
            { rects: Array.prototype.slice.call(card.querySelectorAll("#rectangleContainer_2 rect")), dots: Array.prototype.slice.call(card.querySelectorAll("#circleContainer_2 circle")) }
        ];
    }

    function clearRack(card) {
        (card._rackGroups || []).forEach(function(group) {
            group.rects.concat(group.dots).forEach(function(el) {
                el.classList.remove("is-led-on", "is-led-dim");
            });
        });
    }

    function setClasses(items, on, dim) {
        items.forEach(function(el, index) {
            el.classList.toggle("is-led-on", on.indexOf(index) !== -1);
            el.classList.toggle("is-led-dim", on.indexOf(index) === -1 && dim.indexOf(index) !== -1);
        });
    }

    function paintRackReference(card) {
        var groups = card._rackGroups || [];
        if (groups[0]) {
            setClasses(groups[0].rects, [1, 2, 7], [3, 6]);
            setClasses(groups[0].dots, [4], [7, 10, 15, 20]);
        }
        if (groups[1]) {
            setClasses(groups[1].rects, [1, 2, 3, 6, 7, 8], [0, 4, 5, 9]);
            setClasses(groups[1].dots, [2, 9, 16, 23], [5, 12, 19, 28]);
        }
        if (groups[2]) {
            setClasses(groups[2].rects, [], [1, 2, 3, 6, 7, 8]);
            setClasses(groups[2].dots, [], [3, 8, 13, 18, 24, 29]);
        }
    }

    function randomRackBlink(card) {
        (card._rackGroups || []).forEach(function(group, row) {
            group.rects.forEach(function(el) {
                if (Math.random() < (row === 1 ? 0.18 : 0.08)) {
                    el.classList.toggle("is-led-on");
                    if (el.classList.contains("is-led-on")) {
                        el.classList.remove("is-led-dim");
                    }
                }
            });
            group.dots.forEach(function(el) {
                if (Math.random() < 0.035) {
                    el.classList.toggle("is-led-on");
                    if (el.classList.contains("is-led-on")) {
                        el.classList.remove("is-led-dim");
                    }
                }
            });
        });
    }

    function activate(card, on) {
        var old = state.get(card);
        card.classList.toggle("is-active", on);
        if (old) {
            old.timeouts.forEach(clearTimeout);
            old.intervals.forEach(clearInterval);
            state.delete(card);
        }
        if (!on) {
            clearRack(card);
            return;
        }
        var timeouts = [];
        var intervals = [];
        paintRackReference(card);
        timeouts.push(setTimeout(function() {
            intervals.push(setInterval(function() {
                randomRackBlink(card);
            }, 420));
        }, 1600));
        state.set(card, { timeouts: timeouts, intervals: intervals });
    }

    function init(root) {
        (root || document).querySelectorAll(".api-card.exact-card").forEach(function(card) {
            if (card.dataset.landingApiReady === "true") {
                return;
            }
            card.dataset.landingApiReady = "true";
            setupApi(card);
            if (hoverable) {
                card.addEventListener("mouseenter", function() { activate(card, true); });
                card.addEventListener("mouseleave", function() { activate(card, false); });
            } else {
                card.addEventListener("click", function() { activate(card, !card.classList.contains("is-active")); });
            }
        });
    }

    init(document);
    document.addEventListener("app-router:patch", function(event) {
        init(event.target || document);
    });
})();
{% end_app_script %}
